description:
Your company's security team has requested a quarterly audit of the Jenkins CI/CD server. You need to use the Jenkins Script Console (located at Manage Jenkins > Script Console) to execute a Groovy script that collects system information and writes it to a file.

The Groovy script must collect the following information and write the audit report to the file path `/var/jenkins_home/audit_report.txt`:

1. Jenkins Version - The exact Jenkins server version
2. JVM Information - The Java/JVM version the server is running on
3. Installed Plugins - A complete listing of ALL installed plugins, each with its short name and version (e.g., git:5.2.1 format)
4. Configured Jobs - A listing of all jobs/items currently configured in Jenkins, including each job's name

The script should write the report to `/var/jenkins_home/audit_report.txt` AND print the output to the Script Console for visual confirmation.

Login credentials:
  Username: admin
  Password: Admin123!

Note: There are several pre-existing jobs already configured in this Jenkins instance that should appear in your audit report.
